"""Review-only PoCs. No production files or PR tests are modified."""

import hashlib
import json
import time

import pytest
from ocr.anonymization.candidate_io import parse_candidate
from ocr.anonymization.engine import AnonymizationEngine
from ocr.anonymization.private_review import PrivateReviewMaterial, ReviewBinding, SourcePageReference
from ocr.anonymization.release_policy import digest
from ocr.schemas import SafeError
from ocr.tests.test_anonymization_security import StubRecognizer, evidence


def test_duplicate_page_manifest_should_be_rejected():
    texts = ("Synthetic first page", "Synthetic second page")
    candidate = AnonymizationEngine(StubRecognizer()).handoff(evidence("D2", texts))
    data = json.loads(candidate.model_dump_json())
    data["pages"][1] = data["pages"][0]
    duplicate = parse_candidate(json.dumps(data))
    # Matching cardinality is not a bijection: page 1 has disappeared.
    assert [p.page_index for p in duplicate.pages] == [0, 0]
    sources = tuple(SourcePageReference(
        evidence_ref=hashlib.sha256(f"synthetic-page-{i}".encode()).hexdigest(),
        page_index=i, sensitivity="D2", sha256=hashlib.sha256(t.encode()).hexdigest(),
        characters=len(t),
    ) for i, t in enumerate(texts))
    with pytest.raises((ValueError, SafeError)):
        PrivateReviewMaterial(
            binding=ReviewBinding(review_ref="review-poc", environment_id="private-poc",
                                  sensitivity="D2", expires_at=int(time.time())+600, revoked=False),
            evidence_digest="a"*64, sources=sources, candidate=duplicate,
            candidate_digest=digest(duplicate), provenance=duplicate.provenance,
            blocking_reason=None,
        )


def test_invalid_replacement_bounds_should_be_rejected_by_parser():
    candidate = AnonymizationEngine(StubRecognizer()).handoff(evidence("D2", ("Synthetic",)))
    data = json.loads(candidate.model_dump_json())
    data["pages"][0]["tags"][0].update(start=9, end=-1)
    with pytest.raises((ValueError, SafeError)):
        parse_candidate(json.dumps(data))
